services.name: Eco Tour
services.desc: 2 Hours About Join our crew aboard The Opa and The Lola for a two-hour Eco Tour discovering wildlife in one of the most ecologically biodiverse ecosystems in the Northern Hemisphere. The Indian River Lagoon is home to over 4,200 different species of plants, animals, and fish. More Info Wheelchair Accessible and Handicapped Friendly. 10% OFF for Seniors 65 and Over, Brevard County Residents and Military. Must show proof of ID upon arrival. services.name: Sunset Cruises
services.desc: 2 Hours About Are you looking for something unique and romantic to spark your inspiration? At Banana River Boat Tours, we offer a variety of tours to help create an unforgettable experience with your family. Begin your evening with a relaxing, enjoyable two-hour Cape Canaveral Sunset Cruise on the Banana River. Once aboard, sit back, relax and soak in the spectacular views of barrier islands and uninhabited spoil islands while watching the sun dip closer to the horizon. services.desc: 2 Hours ONLY AVAILABLE JUNE - SEPTEMBER About These tours are a unique way to experience nature and see some of the most beautiful creatures in the world at night. Bioluminescence occurs seasonally in our area when the water reaches a certain temperature… very, very warm. It’s an amazing sight to behold and something that you will never forget. A natural occurring phenomenon. During these tours, you can relax on a pontoon boat through waters that are teeming with bioluminescence.
